lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately nine high-luminance circular spots are visible on the caudal peduncle, arranged in three vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the spots to form a grid-like pattern on the caudal peduncle.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal ridges run along the caudal peduncle, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A dark, narrow horizontal mark or lesion is present on the mid-lateral line of the caudal peduncle near the insertion point of the tail.
other_distinctive_markers: Low-contrast, high-luminance spots are distributed across the proximal regions of both the upper and lower lobes of the caudal fin.
